## Description {#details}

<p>Aggregated check and test case counters for a node in the test tree.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/counters">counters</a></span> records five counters that are maintained throughout a test session:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>the number of checks that passed (<span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a454de640619adaeeb5cbc2ada7144946">passed_checks_</a></span>),</li>
<li>the number of checks that failed (<span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a903b0e792447e149a032a7e46570bfc1">failed_checks_</a></span>),</li>
<li>the number of test cases that were executed (<span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a72fb6b1038be0ac8b09b4da60aa292e8">executed_test_cases_</a></span>),</li>
<li>the number of those test cases that failed (<span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a09550bb4fd851f9b704904311bba27b6">failed_test_cases_</a></span>), and</li>
<li>the number of test cases skipped by the filter (<span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#a4399ece2b4eb697927d7cf205d5b18d9">skipped_test_cases_</a></span>).</li>
</ul>

<p>For a test case, the test case counters refer only to its direct nested test cases; for a suite or the runner, they refer to the test cases at all nesting levels.</p>


<p>The runner and every node of the test tree (<span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/suite">suite</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/test-case">test_case</a></span>) own a <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/counters">counters</a></span> member and accumulate their counts in place. At the end of each suite or session the operator <span class="doxyComputerOutput">+=</span> propagates the child totals up to the parent node, or to the runner.</p>


<p>The tests can read the counters of the runner, of a suite, or of a test case through the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">totals()</span> accessor.</p>


<p>The class is a copyable value type, so that a test can take a snapshot of the counters (<span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/counters">counters</a> before = ts.totals ();</span>) and compare it later with the current values. The copy is independent: it is not updated when the original counters change. The nodes that own the live counters are themselves neither copyable nor movable. The runner returns only a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">const</span> reference; the suites and the test cases also have a non-<span class="doxyComputerOutput">const</span> overload, kept for v5.0.1, but the counters of the nodes are meant to be read only.</p>


<p>Definition at line 108 of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/counters-h">counters.h</a>.</p>

<p>Checks whether all executed checks and test cases were successful.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Parameters</dt>
